verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents its own REST API with an OpenAPI spec. Its docs note that test requests create, change and delete real records, so API-based read/write of CRM records is evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents scale behaviour, rate limits, upsert semantics or change detection (modified-since filters, webhooks), which are the core of the sync story. Missing for 10: documented rate limits, upsert/idempotent write endpoints, change detection (delta queries, timestamps or webhooks), evidence of bulk/at-scale sync, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync records bidirectionally through the API at scale, with documented rate limits, upserts, and change detection
